title: lavatera thuringiaca subsp. cachemiriana
intro: Lavatera thuringiaca subsp. cachemiriana, commonly known as Kashmir Mallow, is a plant species in the family Malvaceae, native to the Kashmir region in the Himalayas. This plant is known for its traditional use in medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Kashmir Mallow are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a potential candidate for further research in pharmacology and traditional medicine.
